# Rift Impostor

> Free social deduction party game for 3 to 10 players, played with League of Legends champions. Everyone sees the same secret champion except one player, the impostor, who has to bluff through the clues. No sign-up, nothing to install; runs in the browser.

Rift Impostor is an unofficial fan project, created under Riot Games' "Legal Jibber Jabber" policy. Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor it.

## How to play

- Each player privately looks at their card. Everyone sees the champion except the impostor.
- Each player says one word about the champion, in order.
- The group votes on who the impostor is. A tie lets the impostor escape.
- Scoring: the impostor gets 3 points if they escape, every other player gets 1 point if the impostor is voted out. First to 10 points wins.
- Optional hint mode: the impostor is told the champion's class (mage, tank, marksman...).

## Modes

- Local: one phone is passed around the group.
- Online: one player creates a room and shares the link; everyone joins from their own device. Clues and arguing happen on a voice call (for example Discord), votes are cast in the app.
